facts.fact: The article's title states it offers 10 restaurant marketing tips for 2026.
The article was published on January 21, 2026.
Adwave recommends airing local TV ads during morning news shows for breakfast specials, midday for lunch, and early evening as families plan dinner.
facts.quote: Air your commercials during peak dining consideration times, such as morning news shows for breakfast specials, midday for lunch, and early evening as families plan dinner.

facts.fact: Adwave recommends posting 3-5 times per week on Instagram and Facebook and daily on TikTok to stay relevant in algorithms.
facts.unit: posts per week on Instagram and Facebook; daily on TikTok
facts.quote: Aim to post 3-5 times per week on Instagram and Facebook and daily on TikTok to stay relevant in algorithms.

facts.fact: Adwave recommends targeting residential zones with geo-targeted ads during dinner hours of 5-8 pm and business districts around lunchtime of 11 am-2 pm.
facts.quote: Target residential zones during dinner hours (5-8 pm) and business districts around lunchtime (11 am-2 pm).

facts.fact: The article recommends that a restaurant's social media calendar include photos, short videos, and customer-generated stories, with no stated numeric minimum for content mix.
facts.quote: Mix up content with photos, short videos (Reels/TikToks), and customer-generated stories.

facts.fact: The page recommends focusing on micro-influencers with 5,000 to 50,000 followers who have a highly engaged, local audience.
facts.quote: Focus on micro-influencers (5k-50k followers) who have a highly engaged, local audience.

facts.fact: In one unnamed eatery's test comparing evening and morning TV spots, its dinner specials drove 40% more foot traffic after 6 p.m., according to Adwave's page.
facts.quote: its dinner specials drove 40% more foot traffic after 6 p.m.

facts.fact: According to an unnamed restaurant example on Adwave's page, testimonial-based ads converted 25% better than standard food imagery.
facts.quote: Another found testimonial-based ads converted 25% better than standard food imagery.

facts.fact: Adwave's page advises running A/B tests for 2 to 4 weeks to gather statistically significant data.
Adwave's page recommends uploading 10 to 15 high-quality photos to a Google Business Profile, covering dishes, interior/exterior, and staff.
facts.quote: Upload high-quality photos (10-15 images of dishes, your interior/exterior, and staff)

facts.fact: As an example incentive, Adwave's page suggests offering 10% off the next order to people who sign up for a newsletter.
facts.quote: Sign up for our newsletter and get 10% off your next order.

facts.fact: A restaurant could offer a $20 credit to both the referrer and the new customer in a referral program, according to Adwave's article.
facts.quote: A restaurant could offer a $20 credit to both the referrer and the new customer, creating a compelling, mutually beneficial reason to spread the word.

facts.fact: Adwave advises restaurants to launch TV commercials 2-3 weeks before a promotion begins.
facts.quote: Launch your TV commercials 2-3 weeks before your promotion begins.

facts.fact: Adwave advises restaurants to map out key campaigns 6-8 weeks ahead of time.
facts.quote: Map out your key campaigns 6-8 weeks ahead of time.

facts.fact: Adwave advises restaurants to respond to every online review on platforms like Google and Yelp within 24-48 hours.
facts.quote: Respond to every review on platforms like Google and Yelp in 24-48 hours.

facts.fact: Adwave's example suggests a steakhouse launch TV spots on networks like Bravo or Food Network two weeks before a Valentine's Day fine-dining promotion.
facts.quote: a steakhouse can run a Valentine's Day fine-dining promotion by launching TV spots on networks like Bravo or Food Network two weeks prior
